name: Moontouched Den
summary: Moontouched Den is a sheltered wildkin hollow tucked into the misty forest slopes of Darkshore, east of Auberdine. Blessed by Elune, the sanctuary is home to sacred wildkin who guard ancient nests and mystical fetishes. However, like much of the coastline, dark and troubling forces have begun disturbing the tranquility of the grove.

sections.title: Sanctuary of the Wildkin
sections.body: Moontouched Den serves as a woodland sanctuary for wildkin, the feathered and antlered guardians tied intimately to the moon goddess Elune. Tucked into the forested ridges east of Auberdine, the enclave features scattered wildkin nests, carved natural fetishes, and secluded burrows. Druids and priests of Elune revere these creatures as embodiment of nature's balance, but travelers must exercise caution, as wildkin aggressively defend their nests from all outside encroachment.

sections.title: Fading Balance
sections.body: Across Darkshore, lingering corruption from the Third War and the sundering of Felwood has cast long shadows over the indigenous wildlife. While Moontouched Den remains a dedicated home for these majestic beast-kin, the growing agitation of the woodlands has put the wildkin on edge, leaving local night elves watchful of any shifts that might further corrupt or disturb this sacred ground.

faq.answer: Moontouched Den is a wildkin hollow located in the hills east of Auberdine in Darkshore. It is recognized by the numerous nests, fetishes, and winding pathways carved out by resident wildkin.
The den is populated by wildkin, also known as owlbeasts or moonkin. These feathered protectors are sacred to the night elves and the goddess Elune, fiercely guarding their nests against intruders.

faq.q: Why are the wildkin sacred to night elves?
aliases: why do night elves like wildkin
faq.answer: Wildkin are believed to have been created or blessed directly by Elune to safeguard pristine natural groves. Night elves and druids regard them with reverence as living manifestations of lunar and natural balance.

faq.q: Are the wildkin in the den friendly to travelers?
faq.answer: No. Despite their sacred connection to Elune, wildkin are extremely territorial and will attack anyone who wanders too close to their young, nests, or sacred grounds.

angles.text: Druids view wildkin as sacred kinsfolk created by Elune, making any corruption or disruption within Moontouched Den a solemn matter for the Cenarion Circle.
Night elves hold the wildkin of Darkshore in deep reverence, respecting their isolated enclaves while warily monitoring them for signs of the corruption spreading along the coast.
